title: wtsi-hgi/hlarnaseq pipeline - params.wgs_samples schema
description: Schema for the WGS samples manifest provided with params.wgs_samples

WGS_sample_id.errorMessage: WGS sample ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

WGS_BAM_path.errorMessage: WGS BAM path must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam'

WGS_BAI_path.errorMessage: WGS BAI path must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must be named '<BAM file name>.bai' (i.e. end in '.bam.bai'), because HLA-LA resolves a BAM's index as '<BAM>.bai' and will not find an index named otherwise
